description: Health, scan performance, and aggregate and per-campground campsite availability for Campground Checker.

panels.description: 1 while the checker is warming up or the latest alert scan is less than two alert intervals old; otherwise 0. Mirrors the health endpoint's 503 condition.
panels.title: Checker Health

panels.description: Seconds since the last completed alert scan. Alert scans run every minute in production, so red at 120s means a missed cycle.
panels.title: Last Alert Scan Age

panels.description: Seconds since the last completed background dashboard scan (every 10 minutes in production). Shows no data until the first dashboard scan completes.
panels.title: Last Dashboard Scan Age

panels.description: Share of the selected range in which configured campgrounds were in a successful-scan state. Unlike scan_errors_total (whole-scan aborts, in "Errors in Selected Range"), this moves when individual campground searches fail while the surrounding scan succeeds.
panels.title: Campground Scan Success Rate

panels.description: Configured campgrounds included in the most recent scan cycle.
panels.title: Campgrounds Monitored

panels.description: Campgrounds with at least one available campsite in the latest combined alert and dashboard results.
panels.title: Campgrounds Available

panels.description: Available campsite-date combinations in the latest results. This is not a count of unique physical sites.
panels.title: Campsites Available

panels.description: Latest available campsite-date combinations for every configured campground, sorted by count. Dashboard-only entries retain their most recent results until the next dashboard scan.
panels.title: Availability by Campground

panels.description: Number of configured campgrounds whose latest provider search failed.
panels.title: Failed Campground Searches

panels.description: Campgrounds whose latest provider search failed. An empty table means every search succeeded.
panels.title: Campgrounds with Search Errors

panels.description: Availability events over the selected time range. Campgrounds with no availability are omitted to keep the view readable.
panels.title: Availability Events

panels.description: Failed searches per campground per hour. The top-level failure stat and table are instantaneous, so an intermittently failing campground is only visible here.
panels.title: Campground Search Failures

panels.description: Monitored campgrounds and campgrounds with availability over time.
panels.title: Campground Availability

panels.description: Total available campsite-date combinations across all campgrounds over time.
panels.title: Available Campsite-Date Combinations

panels.description: Share of monitored campgrounds with at least one available campsite.
panels.title: Campground Availability Rate

panels.description: Wall-clock duration of each priority alert search. Dashboard rendering and R2 publication run independently and are excluded.
panels.title: Alert Cycle Duration

panels.description: Hourly completion and error rates for foreground alert scan cycles.
panels.title: Scan Throughput and Errors

panels.description: Hourly Telegram alert delivery and failure rates, averaged over at least an hour. Failed sends defer the dedup checkpoint and are retried next scan.
panels.title: Telegram Notifications

panels.description: Completed scan cycles over the selected time range.
panels.title: Scans in Selected Range

panels.description: Scan cycles that ended with an unhandled error over the selected time range.
panels.title: Errors in Selected Range

panels.description: Telegram alerts delivered and failed over the selected time range. Any failure defers the dedup checkpoint, so the alert is retried on the next scan.
panels.title: Notifications in Selected Range

panels.description: Time since the checker process started. A recent restart explains drops in the range-scoped counters on this dashboard.
panels.title: Process Uptime

panels.description: Provider rate limits, native request retries, and native request failures per hour, averaged over at least an hour.
panels.title: Provider Rate-limit Events

panels.description: Remaining adaptive cooldown by provider (solid) and the most recent backoff applied (dashed). A zero cooldown means requests are allowed.
panels.title: Adaptive Provider Cooldown

panels.description: Consecutive rate-limit responses per provider without a subsequent successful request. Each consecutive hit doubles the adaptive backoff; the streak clears on the next successful request.
panels.title: Consecutive Provider Rate Limits

panels.description: Current state of the background dashboard scanner and isolated dashboard publisher.
panels.title: Dashboard Worker

panels.description: Separate timings for provider scanning, dashboard publication, HTML rendering, and Cloudflare R2 upload.
panels.title: Dashboard Work Duration

panels.description: Hourly completion and error rates for background dashboard scans, publication cycles, and R2 uploads, averaged over at least a 30-minute window.
panels.title: Dashboard Throughput and Errors

list.description: Filter per-campground panels by alert or dashboard-only tier.
list.label: Alert tier
list.name: alert
